name: digital_arrest_hinglish
lines: hello namaste kya main verma ji se baat kar raha hoon
main mumbai cyber crime branch se inspector vikram singh bol raha hoon
aapke aadhaar card se ek parcel book hua hai jisme drugs mile hain
aapka naam money laundering case mein aaya hai aapke naam se arrest warrant nikla hai
yeh call mat kaatna kisi ko mat batana ghar walon ko bhi nahi yeh confidential investigation hai
video call pe raho camera on rakho
apni begunahi saabit karne ke liye apne account ka paisa rbi ke safe account mein transfer kijiye
